purpose: Test Jev as a 5-session direction challenger on numerically eligible strong stocks; no news.
target: next regular-session OPEN to fifth future regular-session CLOSE simple return > 0
rank_universe: current reconstructed stock cache with valid 189-session return, Price>=5, DDV20>=10M
unavailable_filter: historical structural-clinical-biotech flag is not available and is not fabricated

selection_per_origin.leaders_rule: highest RS189 percentile, then RS63 percentile, then ticker
selection_per_origin.controls_rule: deterministic SHA256(origin|ticker) order among remaining eligible names

jev.input: 59 numeric features only; no news, no options, no ticker-name inference requested
jev.question: binary 5-session terminal direction

comparator.type: L2 logistic regression fit only on development cases
comparator.feature_set: same numeric feature vector with dev-only median imputation and standardization

holdout_policy: No parameters, feature definitions, selection rules, calibration, or weights may change after holdout results are observed.
